newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close up on Petron rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close up on Petron rise.

text.p: * Value of shares traded at 4 billion pesos
Manila shares ended up on Friday on buying in blue chips like oil firm Petron Corp, traders said.
"The index-linked issues are keeping the market afloat. We see positioning by foreigners as B shares are pretty active," said Allan Araullo, vice-president at Regina Capital Development Corp said.
The main index rose by 26.42 points, or 0.86 percent, to close at 3,090.16 points.
Aside from Petron, index-related issues that gained include Ayala Corp, Ayala Land, San Miguel B, and Meralco B.
The top three among the most actively traded stocks were Centennial City Inc, Mabuhay Holdings Corp and Bank of Philippine Islands.
Decliners beat gainers 66 to 50 with 81 issues unchanged.
Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Securities Inc, said the market would start to rise slowly next week as investors begin positioning for 1997.
Araullo said that while second and thirdliners have been the centre of attention for the past two weeks, focus will be riveted on blue chips by next week.
